reuse.why: Takes its category set from the shared getMonthFillCategories selection and its sign from averageToBudgetAmount, exactly like the existing average actions.

duplication.why: Only the small per-action loop (read value, setBudget) is written, which is the action's own variation; no selection or sign logic is copied.

placement.why: The action is in budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Adds only the action, its registration and a release note, which this repo uses for every change.

maintainability.why: Short, consistent with siblings, and any future change to category selection applies automatically; the redundant '|| 0' is a trivial nit.
